nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What are electronic healthcare devices (EHDs) considered as compared to conventional healthcare equipment?
nodes.answer: EHDs are considered alternative solutions to conventional healthcare equipment, offering reliable diagnostics, self-monitoring capabilities, improved patient comfort, and less invasive procedures.
nodes.paragraph: The proliferation of healthcare technologies has been driven by global concerns about an aging population, epidemics, pan- demics, health inequalities, and escalating healthcare costs (Abernethy et al. 2022).
